x-e-m1-01.title: Ben ma imaan doonaa xafladda? Baarista macnaha qarsoon ee jawaabihiisa
x-e-m1-01.goal: U kala qaybi jawaabaha Ben ee wada hadalka sadar sadar, kala saar waxa la dejiyay iyo waxa hadhay, oo samee go'aan adigoo aan sheegin 'wuu iman doonaa' ama 'ma iman doono.'
x-e-m1-01.material:
Wada hadal u dhexeeya Jisu iyo Ben (waxaa loo qoray sida qoraal oo keliya, sawir la'aan):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
x-e-m1-01.thinking.0: Samaynta go'aan adigoo isku daraya tilmaamaha dhowr sadar
x-e-m1-01.thinking.1: Kala saarista erayada suurtagalnimada sida 'might' iyo 'probably'
x-e-m1-01.thinking.2: U kala qaybinta dhibaatooyinka la dejiyay iyo kuwa hadhay
x-e-m1-01.prereq.0: Macnaha tibaaxaha fudud sida might, probably, iyo check with
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.prompt: Akhri wada hadalka ilaa dhammaadka oo dooro go'aanka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan haddii Ben imaan doono xafladda.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.hint.0: U kala qaybi hadalka Ben afar qaybood: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' iyo 'mom.'
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig waqtiga ciyaarta kubbadda cagta iyo waqtiga xafladda oo is barbar dhig haddii ay is dhaafaan.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.a: 'Might' wuxuu muujiyaa suurtagalnimo oo keliya. Dib u eeg oo hubi haddii aad akhridday waxa Ben ka dib yidhi.

x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.c: Ciyaarta kubbadda cagtu waa subaxda xafladduna waa 4 p.m. Is barbar dhig labada waqti isbarbar.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.d: 'Tired' waa walwal Ben isagu ku daray. Ka fikir haddii aad kaliya akhrin karto sidii diidmo.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.explain: Ciyaarta kubbadda cagtu waa subaxda xafladduna waa 4 p.m., sidaas darteed waqtiyadu is ma dhaafaan. Ben wuxuu oo keliya yiri laga yaabaa inuu daalan yahay, dhammaadkana wuxuu yiri wuxuu marka hore hubin doonaa hooyadiis. Sidaas darteed waxaa jira wax la dejiyay (waqtiga) iyo wax hadhay (oggolaanshaha hooyadiis), weliba lama go'aamin.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.prompt: Qor laba ama saddex weedhood oo Af-Kuuriyaan ah oo bixinaya sababaha go'aanka kore. Soo xigo ugu yaraan hal tibaax Ingiriisi ah oo Ben ah, oo sheeg waxa la dejiyay iyo waxa hadhay.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor hal shay oo la dejiyay iyo waqtigiisa.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka dibna ka hel hadalka ugu dambeeya ee Ben waxa hadhay oo qor.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay labadaba caddaynta waqtiga iyo waxa hadhay?

x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma ka fogaatay sheegidda 'wuu iman doonaa/ma iman doono'?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.0: Ciyaarta kubbadda cagtu waa subaxda xafladduna waa 4 p.m., sidaas darteed waqtiyadu is ma dhaafaan. Laakiin Ben wuxuu yiri 'Let me check with my mom first.', sidaas darteed oggolaanshaha hooyadiis ayaa hadhay, waxaanan go'aamiyay inaynaan weli ogeyn.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.1: 'That might work' macnaheedu waa suurtagal, ciyaar subaxda ah iyo xaflad 4 p.m. ah is ma dhaafaan. Daal waa walwal oo keliya, maadaama dhammaadka uu yiri wuxuu hubin doonaa hooyadiis, go'aanku wuxuu ku xiran yahay jawaabta hooyadiis.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab wanaagsan oo si gooni ah u qiimeysay daalka.
